newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks rebound at close on blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks rebound at close on blue chips.

text.p: Pakistan stocks rebounded to jump the 1,500-point barrier towards the close on Thursday, but overall sentiment remained weak before the forthcoming 1997/98 (July-June) budget, dealers said.
"Select blue chips, including Engro Chemicals and PSO, rose on fresh buying by foreigners," dealer Shakil Anwar said. "But trading remained dull and sentiment negative before the budget."
The Karachi 100-share index rose 2.30 points, or 0.15 percent, to end at 1,504.62. Losers led gainers 192 to 96. Engro Chemicals rose 3.0 rupees to 136.25. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
